message.content:
Here’s a list of the long weekends (public holidays that fall on a Friday or Monday, creating a three‑day weekend) in Canada for the year 2023:

| Date | Holiday | Day of Week | Notes |
|------|---------|-------------|-------|
| **January 1** | New Year’s Day | Sunday | (No long weekend) |
| **January 2** | New Year’s Day (Observed) | Monday | Observed because New Year’s Day fell on Sunday |
| **February 20** | Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario) | Monday | Long weekend in those provinces |
| **March 20** | Good Friday | Friday | Long weekend (Good Friday + Easter Monday) |
| **April 7** | Victoria Day | Monday | Long weekend |
| **May 22** | Victoria Day (observed) | Monday | (If Victoria Day falls on a Sunday, it’s observed on Monday) |
| **June 19** | Canada Day | Saturday | (No long weekend) |
| **July 1** | Canada Day | Saturday | (No long weekend) |
| **July 3** | Canada Day (Observed) | Monday | Observed because Canada Day fell on Saturday |
| **September 4** | Labour Day | Monday | Long weekend |
| **October 9** | Thanksgiving (Canada) | Monday | Long weekend |
| **November 10** | Remembrance Day (observed) | Monday | Observed because Remembrance Day fell on Saturday |
| **December 25** | Christmas Day | Monday | Long weekend |
| **December 26** | Boxing Day | Tuesday | (No long weekend) |

**Key points:**

- **New Year’s Day** is observed on Monday, January 2, 2023, because the actual holiday fell on Sunday.
- **Family Day** is a statutory holiday in Alberta, Saskatchewan, and Ontario. It falls on Monday, February 20, 2023, creating a long weekend in those provinces.
- **Good Friday** falls on Friday, March 20, 2023, and is followed by Easter Monday (April 2) in many provinces, giving a four‑day weekend.
- **Victoria Day** falls on Monday, May 22, 2023, creating a long weekend.
- **Canada Day** falls on Saturday, July 1, 2023, so it is observed on Monday, July 3, 2023, creating a long weekend.
- **Labour Day** falls on Monday, September 4, 2023, creating a long weekend.
- **Thanksgiving** falls on Monday, October 9, 2023, creating a long weekend.
- **Remembrance Day** falls on Saturday, November 11, 2023, so it is observed on Monday, November 10, 2023, creating a long weekend.
- **Christmas Day** falls on Monday, December 25, 2023, creating a long weekend.

Feel free to let me know if you need more details or a breakdown by province!
